decision: PHASE 09S 2026 BIR AUDIT BASELINE INTEGRATION SCAFFOLD PASS WITH STRICT RECOMMENDATIONS
objective: Provide a design-only, non-runtime-active scaffold integrating the 2026 BIR audit-procedure baseline (RMO No. 1-2026, RMO No. 6-2026, RMC No. 14-2026, RMC No. 8-2026, RMC No. 5-2026, RMC No. 107-2025, RR No. 18-2013, RR No. 12-99 as amended, NIRC Sec. 203/222/228/232, CTA rules, and related LOA/eLA/due-process/prescription jurisprudence) into TINA's Phase 9 BIR Audit Defense workflow layer as design-level review signals only. This scaffold does not decide validity, invalidity, voidness, cancellation, finality, enforceability, or appealability of any LOA/eLA/replacement eLA/consolidated notice/PAN/FAN/FLD/FDDA/assessment.

REPLACEMENT_ELA_FOR_CONTINUITY.userQuery: SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC. received a replacement eLA said to be for continuity. What should we check?

REPLACEMENT_ELA_SCOPE_EXPANSION.userQuery: DEMO LOGISTICS CORP. received a replacement eLA that appears broader than the original. Should we be concerned?

MULTIPLE_ELAS_SAME_YEAR.userQuery: SYNTHETIC HOLDINGS INC. received two separate eLAs for the same taxable year. Is this expected under the 2026 framework?

CONSOLIDATED_PAN.userQuery: MODEL VAT TAXPAYER CORP. received a consolidated PAN covering multiple prior notices for the same year.

CONSOLIDATED_FAN.userQuery: SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC. received a consolidated FAN/FLD after two prior eLAs were combined.

FDDA_STAGE_NO_CONSOLIDATION.userQuery: DEMO LOGISTICS CORP.'s case is already at FDDA stage. Can this still be consolidated with a newer eLA?

FINAL_EXECUTORY_FAN_NO_CONSOLIDATION.userQuery: SYNTHETIC HOLDINGS INC. has a FAN that has become final and executory. Can it be folded into a new consolidated audit?

VAT_NON_CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST.userQuery: MODEL VAT TAXPAYER CORP. wants to request non-consolidation of its pending VAT audit case.

VATAS_LTVAU_TRANSITION.userQuery: SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC.'s VAT audit was originally handled by VATAS/LTVAU. What transition issues should we track?

VAT_REFUND_TRANSITION.userQuery: DEMO LOGISTICS CORP. has a pending VAT refund claim affected by the VATAS/LTVAU transition.

TVN_LIMITED_SCOPE.userQuery: SYNTHETIC HOLDINGS INC. received a Tax Verification Notice limited to one specific transaction.

TVN_SCOPE_EXPANSION_RISK.userQuery: MODEL VAT TAXPAYER CORP.'s TVN examiner is now asking about matters beyond the stated transaction.

STANDARDIZED_CHECKLIST.userQuery: SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC. received the standardized checklist of requirements with its LOA.

ADDITIONAL_DOCUMENT_REQUEST_LIMIT.userQuery: DEMO LOGISTICS CORP. received an additional document request beyond the original checklist.

VOLUMINOUS_RECORDS_ON_PREMISE_CERTIFIED_.userQuery: SYNTHETIC HOLDINGS INC. has voluminous accounting records and is asking about on-premise examination and certified copies.

WAIVER_OF_PRESCRIPTION.userQuery: MODEL VAT TAXPAYER CORP. was asked to sign a waiver of the statute of limitations.

WRITTEN_CONFORMITY_TO_CONSOLIDATION.userQuery: SAMPLE TAXPAYER INC. was asked to sign written conformity to consolidate two pending audits.

LOA_RECEIVED_2026_BASELINE.userQuery: DEMO LOGISTICS CORP. just received a BIR LOA under the 2026 single-instance audit framework. What should we do first?
